svg.title: Team Charter
svg.desc: A3 landscape team charter: purpose, members and roles, values, working agreements, decision methods, ways of working, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and conflict and review.
svg.text: Agree why the team exists, how it works together, and what Ready and Done mean, before the work starts.
Team Formation · Working Agreements · Definition of Ready & Done · Review It as the Team Changes
3–5 values, each with an example of it in action
Communication, core hours, meetings, feedback, how we handle interruptions
One agreement per sticky, written as “We…”
Default method, and who decides what:
e.g. value is clear, it's small enough, examples agreed
“What would make this the best team any of us has worked on?”
“Which of these agreements will we find hardest to keep?”
Team Formation · Working Agreements · Continuous Improvement
